title: LotPlan
description: One building's brief: the ids its floors must use, the room its front door opens into, where its way out leads back to, and how big it should be. Coordinates are deliberately absent: a building interior is its own space.

label.description: Name shown on the map overlay and over the door.

program.description: The room mix to build: what the place is for.

floorInstanceIds.description: Instance id per floor, ground floor first. The street door links to the first.

entryRoomId.description: Room on the ground floor that the street door opens into. The building must contain it.

returnInstanceId.description: Instance the way out leads back to (the street). Omit for a building that stands on its own: its front door becomes a plain EXIT instead.

returnRoomId.description: Room the player lands in on the way out. Required alongside returnInstanceId.

returnAt.description: Exact spot the way out leaves you, in the street's coordinates: the pavement in front of this building's own door. Without it you land in the middle of the room, which on open ground is the middle of the city.

returnFacing.description: Which way you are looking when you come out, in radians: away from the building.

doorPortalId.description: The street-side portal, already present in the street instance.

quest.description: The run's objective sits in this building: the named item is placed on the given floor, and finding it is that floor's goal.

footprint.description: Size to build each floor to, in metres.

itemId.description: Id of the item to find, and the name the goal is written in.

floor.description: Which floor holds it, ground floor 1. Default: the top floor.
